left_out.doc/, docs/, assets/, *.md, presets/, do: documentation, decensor presets (tensors), containers, CI and packaging
left_out.exllamav3/architecture/: model architecture definitions (42 changed or added); model code, not kernels or runtime pieces

left_out.exllamav3/model/ (other than the harvest: engine plumbing changed for the fork
left_out.exllamav3/modules/*.py (changed base mod: the engine module graph as Kyojin changed it; the kernels and runtime pieces they call are harvested
left_out.tests/, eval/, examples/, science/, ref/: tests, evaluations, examples and CPU references; not run here
left_out.tools/ (everything but the serve files i: benchmarks, probes, A/B scripts, qualification, conversion and release tooling
